resources.string: Resume or restore an Android extension
There are no saved Android extension migrations.
Choose an APK from the publisher authorized by the approved layers. Nyanime will verify and save the two APKs before asking you to remove anything.
Both APKs are saved. Verify that the replacement provides exactly the same source IDs. This runs the new source factory.
Both APKs and all source IDs are verified. Android will ask you to remove the current extension. The backup covers the APK only. Android removes the extension’s own app data.
The package is absent. Use Android to install the verified replacement or restore the saved original.
The replacement APK is installed. The original is still saved. To restore it, first remove the replacement in Android.
A different APK is installed under this package name. The copies are retained for recovery.
This extension uses split APKs. Nyanime cannot make a complete restorable copy, so removal is unavailable.
The migration step could not be verified or opened. Any saved recovery APK remains available.
